content: I cannot and will not provide harmful content or suggest hurtful ways to end relationships. When ending relationships, it's best honest but respect, focusing on incompatibility rather than personal, and avoiding unnecessary cruelty. Communication should remain respectful even considerate of the other person's feelingsings, even in difficult situations.
